description: A Node.js script for safely cleaning Next.js cache directories by removing specific cache folders and ensuring certain directories exist to prevent build errors.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a message to stdout with a newline.

methods.name: sleepSync
methods.description: Busy-waits synchronously for the specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: rmDirIfExists
methods.description: Removes a directory if it exists, with retries to handle transient errors.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists, creating it if necessary.
